scope: October 13, 2025 Law; common rules, four base factions, Autumn/Fall and Winter, Thief/Tinker/Ranger, dominance and coalition. Exclude expansion factions/content, second Vagabond, other characters, hirelings, landmarks, bots, Advanced Setup.

independence.authoritative_read: Complete applicable extracted text and matching PDF pages 2-10, C.1 on 24, Glossary 25-26, M.1-2 on 27, V.1-3 on 28; PDF title date October 13, 2025.

findings.finding: No existing question directly asks the Vagabond Daylight action allowance or permission to choose/repeat actions in any order and number. The ledger maps 9.5.1-2 and each individual action, but does not separately map the 9.5 preamble.

question_wording_check.Q17: Requests Refresh, Slip, Move, forest Rest and drawing; no Daylight action economy.
question_wording_check.Q18: Requests Explore, Quest and Repair procedures; no permission to interleave/repeat Daylight actions.
question_wording_check.Q19: Requests Hostility, Infamy and Strike targeting.
question_wording_check.Q53: Repeated Aid relationship accounting is requested; that is not general action selection/order.
question_wording_check.Q56: Crafting piece reuse is requested; that is not all Daylight action repetition/interleaving.
question_wording_check.Q57: Character specials and Ranger end-Daylight exception only.
question_wording_check.Q75: Cost of initiating one Battle action; no action allowance.
question_wording_check.Q73: The same kind of phase permission is directly tested for Alliance, whose faction rule cannot establish Vagabond coverage.

findings.novelty: Distinct explicit faction phase procedure. Allows continued/repeated/interleaved Daylight action selection subject to item costs; not inferred from how an individual action works. Not a numerical variant or mechanical recombination.

proposed_questions.question: How many Daylight actions may the Vagabond take, must the action types follow a fixed order, and may the same action type be repeated?
proposed_questions.expected_answer: The Vagabond may take Daylight actions in any order and number, repeating or interleaving action types as desired, provided each action can pay its item costs and meet its other requirements. There is no separate fixed action-count allowance. Ranger Hideout still immediately ends Daylight as specified.
proposed_questions.novelty: Tests the currently unrequested 9.5 any-order-and-number phase permission. Item eligibility and Ranger are context already tested elsewhere, not counted as additional novelty.

notes: Keys are concise but no keyed ruling contradicts the assigned Law in scope. A general Decree procedural answer in Q12 already requests normal Recruit; its terse at-matching-roost phrasing is not a separate new coverage gap.
Q77 preserving current face follows literal damage instruction with no instruction to flip; Repair and Rest expressly distinguish side changes.
Q46 establishes Outrage trigger; which player pays after a forced allied move is application of Q28 and Q14 rather than a new rule.

q78_novelty.new_procedure: One Alliance Recruit operation places one supply warrior in one chosen clearing with a base.
q78_novelty.comparison: Q47 asks which operations are available, whether officers are consumed and when cards are drawn. Its contextual key gives Recruit detail, but its wording does not request the count/destination procedure. Q78 directly requests those details.
q78_novelty.redundant_portion: The operation budget overlaps contextual Q47/Q16 key material; the new Recruit procedure is sufficient independent novelty.

zero_addition_passes_9_10.reason: Both passes can be recorded as historical zero-addition searches, but they missed the direct 9.5 phase preamble.
